objective: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

description: I've written a letter of thanks to Zargh.  Will you deliver it for me?  If you've already been to the Crossroads and spoken with their wind rider master, then you can fly a wind rider back there.
Take my letter to Doras, the wind rider master of Orgrimmar, and speak with him about transport to the Crossroads.
progress: Do you need one of my wind riders?
completion: You have to get this to the Crossroads in the Barrens? Yes, I can get you there...
